description: This file defines the ListViewController class for handling list view operations within the vtiger CRM, including fetching and rendering list entries, configuring sortable headers, managing linked data like owner names and reference fields, and generating action links.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controller class for managing list views in vtiger CRM, including fetching list entries, sorting, header generation, and action link creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewController with database, user, and query generator objects.

methods.name: isHeaderSortingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether header sorting is enabled in the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderSorting
methods.description: Enables or disables header sorting in the list view.

methods.name: setupAccessiblePicklistValueList
methods.description: Configures picklist values based on user roles for a given picklist name.

methods.name: fetchNameList
methods.description: Retrieves and caches names for reference fields in the list view.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Generates the list view entries with data and action links, handling data formatting and permissions.

methods.name: getListViewEditLink
methods.description: Constructs the URL for editing a record in the list view.

methods.name: getListViewDeleteLink
methods.description: Constructs the URL for deleting a record from the list view.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Builds the list view table headers with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: getBasicSearchFieldInfoList
methods.description: Provides a list of fields available for basic search.

methods.name: getAdvancedSearchOptionString
methods.description: Returns an HTML string of options for advanced search configuration.
